HELP.TITLE: How to use Memshot
HELP.SECTION_PHOTO_TEXT: Press the large white button to take a photo. It's automatically sent to the gallery for everyone to see! Switch to front camera with the rotate icon at the top right.
HELP.SECTION_VIDEO_TEXT: Tap Video at the bottom to switch modes, then press the red button to start recording (max 90 seconds). Press again to stop. The video is sent automatically.
HELP.SECTION_GALLERY_TEXT: All shared photos and videos are visible in the gallery. Tap one to view it full screen, then swipe left or right to navigate between them.
HELP.SECTION_DOWNLOAD_TEXT: Open a photo and tap the download icon to save it. To download several at once, tap the select icon in the top right, choose your photos, then download the selection.
HELP.SECTION_EVENTS_TEXT: All your events are listed here. Tap an event to open its gallery. Each card shows the number of photos and whether the event is live or closed.
HELP.SECTION_OPEN_CLOSE_TEXT: Tap the lock icon on a card to close submissions — guests will no longer be able to add photos. Tap it again to reopen. You can also swipe a card left to reveal a quick delete.
HELP.SECTION_QR_TEXT: Tap QR Code on a card to display the QR code. Guests scan it to join instantly. You can also copy the direct link to share it via message or email.
HELP.SECTION_MANAGE_TEXT: Open a gallery to see all photos. As organizer, tap any photo to delete it, or use Select (top right) to pick multiple photos and download or delete them all at once.
